what_this_release_delivers: #196 modern webapp UI redesign: unifies the top navigation bar (brand + repo identity, centered game slide-deck switcher, and feedback/requests actions), removes the redundant Canvas button from the header (preserving Ctrl/Cmd+K and ~ keyboard shortcuts), relocates ThemeSwitcher (Slate | Sand | Dusk) into the Requests panel footer, and introduces a two-column hero showcase card with live SVG board previews, backdrop artwork, specs, and keyboard controls

#195 locked 2-player Puzzle Bobble layout geometry: fixes .pb-player-card (360px), .pb-player-header (36px with a single priority status pill), .pb-arena-row (338px), .pb-board (224px x 296px), .pb-side (104px x 296px), and .pb-combo-bar (26px) so player boards never change width or shift horizontally during play
carried_known_gaps: Richer in-app evidence (element targeting, screenshots, annotation) remains deferred as #170.
12 of 75 visual captures can differ back-to-back because motion frames are captured with the animation live; 3 more differ at glyph rasterization (#145).
The first-login path (gh auth login --web) remains unverified live.
